svg.title: A nurse is performing a neurovascular assessment on a casted leg. Which findings should the nurse report to the provider?
svg.desc: Capillary refill should return within 3 seconds, the limb should be warm and normal in color, and sensation should be intact. Pain on PASSIVE movement is a hallmark of rising compartment pressure. Being able to move the toes and having an equal, palpable pulse are the expected findings.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Neurovascular Assessment
Read the situation
A nurse is performing a neurovascular
assessment on a casted leg. Which findings
should the nurse report to the provider?
What fits here
Capillary refill of 5 seconds in the toes
· Toes cool and pale compared with the
other foot · Client reports numbness and
tingling in the toes · Pain that increases
when the toes are…
Why it fits
Capillary refill should return within 3
seconds, the limb should be warm and
normal in color, and sensation should be
intact. Pain on PASSIVE movement is a
hallmark of rising compartment pressure.
Being able to move the toes and having an
equal, palpable pulse are the expected
findings.
